programme.title: While The Men Are Away
programme.desc: Esther has uncovered a dead body in the freshly ploughed field and tells Gwen. They're interrupted by Frankie and Kathleen who admit the corpse is Harry - they hid his death in a farming accident in order to keep possession of the farm. programme.title: Faking Influence
programme.desc: The Feed takes a deep dive into the murky world of social media influencers. In a wild experiment, journalist Calliste Weitenberg and producer Elise Potaka build a fake influencer persona to see if they can cash in on what’s now a $15 billion industry. Documenting the process over six months, the series examines the rise of a new frontier in advertising, where influencers are paid or given contra to spruik products. Everyone is out to make a buck, but at what cost?

programme.title: Faking Influence
programme.desc: The Feed continues its investigation into the murky world of social media influencers. This week, journalist Calliste Weitenberg tries everything to grow her fake Instagram account - from fake tan to awkward bikini selfies. But with her follower count staying stubbornly low, she turns to dodgy websites that offer fake followers for cash. Will she get caught? Or has Calliste just bought her way into the $15 billion influencer marketing industry?

programme.title: While The Men Are Away
programme.desc: Esther has uncovered a dead body in the freshly ploughed field and tells Gwen. They're interrupted by Frankie and Kathleen who admit the corpse is Harry - they hid his death in a farming accident in order to keep possession of the farm. programme.title: While The Men Are Away
programme.desc: Esther has uncovered a dead body in the freshly ploughed field and tells Gwen. They're interrupted by Frankie and Kathleen who admit the corpse is Harry - they hid his death in a farming accident in order to keep possession of the farm. Given that Australia is at war with Italy, Frankie is currently an enemy of the Empire and the farm would go to Harry's insufferable brother, Des. Harry's death also meant Kathleen was at risk of being shipped away for work.

The plant life and the spores from the jungle are poisonous to humans. Anyone who ventures into the jungle must wear breathing masks to protect their lungs. The Valley of the Wind is a small community of humans protected by sea breezes from the toxic spores. Their young princess, Nausicaä, tries to understand, rather than destroy the Toxic Jungle. Arriving at The Racha Room, Luke and Chris cook a Thai Red Duck leg Curry overlooking the busy restaurant before Luke plates up a light salmon sashimi with galangal dressing. Finishing the night, Luke entertains his friends at a dinner party making Banh Xeo.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail

Luke then takes us behind the scenes at Grain, his cooking school in Saigon, where he aims to educate others on Vietnamese cooking. We get an inside look at his cooking studio classes cooking some impressive, yet simple traditional delights with pumpkin flowers, fish, prawns and his favourite Nuoc Cham sauce. Tying back into his morning ritual of Pho, he cooks a quick simple Pho Noodle recipe before ending the day at Xu bar.

programme.title: While The Men Are Away
programme.desc: Esther has uncovered a dead body in the freshly ploughed field and tells Gwen. They're interrupted by Frankie and Kathleen who admit the corpse is Harry - they hid his death in a farming accident in order to keep possession of the farm. Given that Australia is at war with Italy, Frankie is currently an enemy of the Empire and the farm would go to Harry's insufferable brother, Des. Harry's death also meant Kathleen was at risk of being shipped away for work.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail

programme.title: While The Men Are Away

Time is now running out, and nobody on board yet realises just how little of it remains.

With his friends, loved ones, and the future of China itself at stake, Wong must once again use his martial arts skills to defend the innocent. Stars Jet Li, Rosamund Kwan and Donnie Yen. Small pockets of humanity survive on the fringes of a vast polluted forest, the Toxic Jungle, inhabited by giant mutated insects, of which the Ohmu, are the greatest threat. The plant life and the spores from the jungle are poisonous to humans. Anyone who ventures into the jungle must wear breathing masks to protect their lungs. The Valley of the Wind is a small community of humans protected by sea breezes from the toxic spores. Their young princess, Nausicaä, tries to understand, rather than destroy the Toxic Jungle. Directed by Hayao Miyazaki, and stars Alison Lohman and Patrick Stewart. (From Japan, in English) (Drama) (1984) (Rpt) PG WS CC

Arriving at The Racha Room, Luke and Chris cook a Thai Red Duck leg Curry overlooking the busy restaurant before Luke plates up a light salmon sashimi with galangal dressing. Finishing the night, Luke entertains his friends at a dinner party making Banh Xeo.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail

Luke then takes us behind the scenes at Grain, his cooking school in Saigon, where he aims to educate others on Vietnamese cooking. We get an inside look at his cooking studio classes cooking some impressive, yet simple traditional delights with pumpkin flowers, fish, prawns and his favourite Nuoc Cham sauce. Tying back into his morning ritual of Pho, he cooks a quick simple Pho Noodle recipe before ending the day at Xu bar.

programme.title: Project Fire

programme.desc: Using knowledge from her grandmother and other family members, Helani Doolah will show and teach us how to make some staple dishes that are made every day in the Torres Strait Islander community.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes

She explores a spicy Singaporean white carrot cake made from daikon radish, known as chai tow kway. Kale is hailed as a superfood, but the Portuguese have been eating it for centuries as part of a delicious warm salad using finely sliced kale, toasted cornbread crumbs and pine nuts.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail
programme.sub-title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail Series 1 Ep 10

Luke visits the best spot for milk tea, a Hong Kong style breakfast Congee and Rice Noodle and he visits one of the only traditional Yum Cha style teahouses in Central Hong Kong. After exploring the traditional side of Hong Kong, Luke visits his friend who adds a modern twist to a Chinese desert using liquid nitrogen.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: It's Pizza Time. Chef Dale Talde grills up amazing pizzas for every palate including a Detroit Style Pie, a Cheddar Naan Pie with a Spiced Chick Peas and Potatoes, and gives childhood favorite French Bread Pizza a much needed upgrade.

programme.title: Project Fire

programme.sub-title: God Speed The Plough And The Woman Who Drives It!
programme.desc: Having retrieved the key to Harry's strong box, Frankie finally has access to money. Gwen and Esther are amazed to finally receive an income in exchange for their labour. Just like a man! Normally Harry's domain, Frankie doles out the wages instead, and for the first time, Kathleen receives her payment alongside the others. Seeing her paid in rations and a handful of coins highlights the vast inequalities between them, and makes everyone deeply uncomfortable.

programme.title: While The Men Are Away
programme.desc: Esther has uncovered a dead body in the freshly ploughed field and tells Gwen. They're interrupted by Frankie and Kathleen who admit the corpse is Harry - they hid his death in a farming accident in order to keep possession of the farm. Given that Australia is at war with Italy, Frankie is currently an enemy of the Empire and the farm would go to Harry's insufferable brother, Des. Harry's death also meant Kathleen was at risk of being shipped away for work.

programme.desc: In the sequel to the Tsui Hark classic, Wong Fei-Hung faces the White Lotus Society, a fanatical cult seeking to drive Europeans out of China through violence, even attacking any Chinese who follow Western ways. Wong must also defend Dr Sun Yat Sen, a revolutionary, from the military. With his friends, loved ones, and the future of China itself at stake, Wong must once again use his martial arts skills to defend the innocent. Stars Jet Li, Rosamund Kwan and Donnie Yen. (From Hong Kong, in Cantonese) (Action/Adventure) (1992) (Rpt) M (V)

programme.title: The Movie Show

programme.title: Nausicaa Of The Valley Of The Wind
programme.desc: A thousand years have passed since the violent collapse of industrial civilisation. Small pockets of humanity survive on the fringes of a vast polluted forest, the Toxic Jungle, inhabited by giant mutated insects, of which the Ohmu, are the greatest threat. The plant life and the spores from the jungle are poisonous to humans. Anyone who ventures into the jungle must wear breathing masks to protect their lungs. The Valley of the Wind is a small community of humans protected by sea breezes from the toxic spores. Their young princess, Nausicaä, tries to understand, rather than destroy the Toxic Jungle. Directed by Hayao Miyazaki, and stars Alison Lohman and Patrick Stewart. (From Japan, in English) (Drama) (1984) (Rpt) PG WS CC

programme.title: Brief Encounter

programme.title: Ghost Dog: The Way Of The Samurai
programme.desc: A Jim Jarmusch classic. Ghost Dog is a hit-man who leads a meticulously ordered existence that is defined by the code of the samurai. Every day he sends his carrier pigeon to old Louie to check if a contract awaits him. A contract arrives to shoot the old lover of a mafia boss's precious daughter. But because the daughter witnesses the murder, the mob wants Ghost Dog dead too. Stars Forest Whitaker, Henry Silva and John Tormey.

programme.title: Zardoz
programme.desc: In a distant future, an Exterminator named Zed infiltrates a secluded society of immortal elites ruled by the godlike Zardoz. As he questions their power, the fragile order of their utopian world begins to collapse.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Japan Bitesize

programme.title: Luca's Key Ingredient

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke visits the city of flowers, known as Dalat, where the French influence can be seen everywhere.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching For France
programme.desc: Avant garde Paris is steeped in the traditions of haute cuisine, dating back to Louis XVI's refinement of dining conventions with his 'art of the table' at the court of Versailles. At Alain Ducasse's Le Meurice Eva eats a single oyster dressed in rhubarb in a flamboyant display reminiscent of the Sun King's food theatre. And she meets the young chefs leading a new food scene, which blends French technique with global influences, including Mory Sacko at MoSuke, and Hanz Gueco at Le Cheval d'Or.

programme.title: Destination Flavour China Bitesize
programme.desc: All the best moments and bits from Destination Flavour China, led by famed chef and author Adam Liaw.

programme.title: Come Dine With Me UK
programme.desc: Fourth to host this week in Bedford and Cambridgeshire is tech entrepreneur Shane. He's hoping to wow his guests with a menu that draws on his Jamaican heritage and his love of high end restaurants.

programme.title: Come Dine With Me UK
programme.desc: The final night of the week sees lady of leisure Michaela attempt an Italian menu inspired by a favourite restaurant near her holiday home.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: The vibes are nourishing in The Cook Up kitchen as Adam and his guests, Young Chef of the Year Jen Kwok Lee and comedian He Huang serve up some soul in a bowl.

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: When it comes to innovative American cheese makers, the state of Vermont has more than it's fair share. The foundations of the dairy industry began here in beautiful New England almost three centuries ago and by a strange coincidence the region has become the center of an exciting new revolution in artisan cheese making. Will and Ellie sample the famous cheddar and also the dairy’s delicious Baylee Hazen Blue cheese and discuss the many government challenges the dairy has faced in recent years and their close bond with the local economy.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Big Daddy Dale Talde shows how to marinate, prep and grill up the biggest and best steaks out there. From a Hanger Steak with Salsa Verde to a Ribeye with Ginger Chili Relish, he tops it all off with the father of all steaks: the Porterhouse.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail
programme.sub-title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail Series 1 Ep 7
programme.desc: With Luke's busy life it's important to find the work life balance. Devoting Sunday as a family day, he explores the outdoors and the variety of restaurants Saigon has to offer. Arriving at The Deck on the Saigon River he meets executive chef Adrian Scott and learns the techniques to his Chicken Won Ton salad. Arriving at The Racha Room, Luke and Chris cook a Thai Red Duck leg Curry overlooking the busy restaurant before Luke plates up a light salmon sashimi with galangal dressing. Finishing the night, Luke entertains his friends at a dinner party making Banh Xeo.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail
programme.sub-title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail Series 1 Ep 8
programme.desc: Luke takes us to his top 3 traditional Pho Restaurants in Saigon and explains the differences between the styles of Pho Broth found throughout Vietnam. Luke then takes us behind the scenes at Grain, his cooking school in Saigon, where he aims to educate others on Vietnamese cooking. We get an inside look at his cooking studio classes cooking some impressive, yet simple traditional delights with pumpkin flowers, fish, prawns and his favourite Nuoc Cham sauce. Tying back into his morning ritual of Pho, he cooks a quick simple Pho Noodle recipe before ending the day at Xu bar.

programme.title: Project Fire
programme.desc: Steak. Few other words in the English language have such power to make our hearts beat faster and our mouths water than sizzling slabs of beef seared over live fire.

programme.title: Kriol Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Helani Doolah: Sop Sop, Sabee Domboi, And Marinated Fried Fish With Battered Banana
programme.desc: Using knowledge from her grandmother and other family members, Helani Doolah will show and teach us how to make some staple dishes that are made every day in the Torres Strait Islander community.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: Years ago Rachael came up with the phrase 'MYOTO,' short for 'make your own takeout,' to encourage people to recreate delicious restaurant meals in their own kitchens.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Laura is joined in the Market Kitchen by Chef Lillie, who makes the famous Vietnamese recipe Banh Mi. Mike changes the pace by cooking Grilled Raddicchio.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians are serious about their celebrations. The food, the company, the conversation, the music, and the wine are always abundant!

programme.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten

programme.title: Freshly Picked
programme.desc: Simon delivers a version of green curry that will please everyone, then takes paratha to the next level by wrapping crispy fried tofu in it. programme.title: Food Safari Earth
programme.desc: Maeve O'Meara celebrates the surprisingly abundant produce of winter across the most heart-warming recipes from around the world. She explores a spicy Singaporean white carrot cake made from daikon radish, known as chai tow kway. Kale is hailed as a superfood, but the Portuguese have been eating it for centuries as part of a delicious warm salad using finely sliced kale, toasted cornbread crumbs and pine nuts.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail

Luke breaks down the barriers behind the logistics of opening a restaurant; from the kitchen to service, and finally, he welcomes us to the opening of Vietnam House. Luke, together with his team of hand-picked chefs, cook a couple of featured dishes of the new menu.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail
programme.sub-title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail Series 1 Ep 10
programme.desc: Luke hits the ground running in Hong Kong taking us to a few of his favourite spots to eat and drink in Hong Kong. Luke visits the best spot for milk tea, a Hong Kong style breakfast Congee and Rice Noodle and he visits one of the only traditional Yum Cha style teahouses in Central Hong Kong. After exploring the traditional side of Hong Kong, Luke visits his friend who adds a modern twist to a Chinese desert using liquid nitrogen.

At Alain Ducasse's Le Meurice Eva eats a single oyster dressed in rhubarb in a flamboyant display reminiscent of the Sun King's food theatre. And she meets the young chefs leading a new food scene, which blends French technique with global influences, including Mory Sacko at MoSuke, and Hanz Gueco at Le Cheval d'Or.

programme.desc: When it comes to innovative American cheese makers, the state of Vermont has more than it's fair share. The foundations of the dairy industry began here in beautiful New England almost three centuries ago and by a strange coincidence the region has become the center of an exciting new revolution in artisan cheese making. Will and Ellie sample the famous cheddar and also the dairy’s delicious Baylee Hazen Blue cheese and discuss the many government challenges the dairy has faced in recent years and their close bond with the local economy.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail
programme.sub-title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail Series 1 Ep 7
programme.desc: With Luke's busy life it's important to find the work life balance. Devoting Sunday as a family day, he explores the outdoors and the variety of restaurants Saigon has to offer. Arriving at The Deck on the Saigon River he meets executive chef Adrian Scott and learns the techniques to his Chicken Won Ton salad. Arriving at The Racha Room, Luke and Chris cook a Thai Red Duck leg Curry overlooking the busy restaurant before Luke plates up a light salmon sashimi with galangal dressing. Finishing the night, Luke entertains his friends at a dinner party making Banh Xeo.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail
programme.sub-title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail Series 1 Ep 8
programme.desc: Luke takes us to his top 3 traditional Pho Restaurants in Saigon and explains the differences between the styles of Pho Broth found throughout Vietnam. Luke then takes us behind the scenes at Grain, his cooking school in Saigon, where he aims to educate others on Vietnamese cooking. We get an inside look at his cooking studio classes cooking some impressive, yet simple traditional delights with pumpkin flowers, fish, prawns and his favourite Nuoc Cham sauce. Tying back into his morning ritual of Pho, he cooks a quick simple Pho Noodle recipe before ending the day at Xu bar.

programme.title: Titanic Sinks Tonight
programme.desc: As Titanic continues her maiden voyage, passengers enjoy the trip of a lifetime, confident they are aboard the safest ship ever built. But in the dead of night, disaster strikes without warning. As crew scramble to assess the damage below deck, a shocking discovery reveals the true scale of the danger. Time is now running out, and nobody on board yet realises just how little of it remains.

programme.title: Six Four
programme.desc: Detective Constable, Chris O'Neill, and his wife Michelle are reeling from the disappearance of their daughter Olivia. Deciding to take matters into her own hands, Michelle travels down to London to search for her, reassuming her undercover identity to reach out to old criminal contacts.

programme.title: SBS World News Late
programme.desc: Latest reports and analysis of major national and international news of the day from Australia's only world news service.

programme.title: Forest Of The Missing
programme.desc: In the heart of the Black Forest, on the French-German border, twelve bodies are found in a mass grave. This macabre discovery rekindles confused memories for Camille Hartmann.

programme.title: Underverden: Darkland
programme.desc: A successful doctor who loses his little brother in a gang-related assault gives up his privileged life to become a masked warrior and avenge his brother's death.

programme.title: Seeking Justice
programme.desc: After his wife is assaulted, a husband enlists the services of a vigilante group to help him settle the score. Then he discovers they want a 'favour' from him in return. When that day comes and Will realizes the true price of revenge is too high for him to pay, the men who once agreed to help him suddenly become his worst enemies.

programme.title: The Tunnel (part 1)
programme.desc: In 1961 Berlin, athlete Harry escapes East Germany but his sister Lotte is trapped. He leads a daring tunnel-digging rescue under the Wall, racing against guards in a tense fight for freedom.

programme.title: Where Angels Fear To Tread
programme.desc: A young English widow's impulsive marriage to an Italian leads to culture clashes, tragedy, and emotional awakening for her conservative in-laws.

programme.title: A Samurai In Time
programme.desc: Struck by lightning, an Edo-era samurai awakens in modern Kyoto and becomes a film extra, discovering an unexpected calling as a master swordsman destined to die on screen.

programme.title: Michael Collins
programme.desc: Neil Jordan's historical biopic of Irish revolutionary Michael Collins, the man who led a guerrilla war against the UK, helped negotiate the creation of the Irish Free State, and led the National Army during the Irish Civil War.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In China 2
programme.desc: In the sequel to the Tsui Hark classic, Wong Fei-Hung faces the White Lotus Society, a fanatical cult seeking to drive Europeans out of China through violence, even attacking any Chinese who follow Western ways. Wong must also defend Dr Sun Yat Sen, a revolutionary, from the military. With his friends, loved ones, and the future of China itself at stake, Wong must once again use his martial arts skills to defend the innocent. Stars Jet Li, Rosamund Kwan and Donnie Yen. (From Hong Kong, in Cantonese) (Action/Adventure) (1992) (Rpt) M (V)

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: Megan Spencer, Jaimie Leonarder and Fenella Kernebone present reviews, interviews and an insider's view of the world of movies, while Marc Fennell reviews DVDs.

programme.title: Nausicaa Of The Valley Of The Wind
programme.desc: A thousand years have passed since the violent collapse of industrial civilisation. Small pockets of humanity survive on the fringes of a vast polluted forest, the Toxic Jungle, inhabited by giant mutated insects, of which the Ohmu, are the greatest threat. The plant life and the spores from the jungle are poisonous to humans. Anyone who ventures into the jungle must wear breathing masks to protect their lungs. The Valley of the Wind is a small community of humans protected by sea breezes from the toxic spores. Their young princess, Nausicaä, tries to understand, rather than destroy the Toxic Jungle. Directed by Hayao Miyazaki, and stars Alison Lohman and Patrick Stewart. (From Japan, in English) (Drama) (1984) (Rpt) PG WS CC

programme.title: Brief Encounter
programme.desc: Brief Encounter by Noel Coward is a touching tale of forbidden love between two married people, Laura and Alex, who must choose between passion and duty. Now remastered in HD.

programme.title: Dog Day Afternoon
programme.desc: A man robs a bank to pay for his lover's operation. It turns into a hostage situation and a media circus.

programme.title: Ghost Dog: The Way Of The Samurai
programme.desc: A Jim Jarmusch classic. Ghost Dog is a hit-man who leads a meticulously ordered existence that is defined by the code of the samurai. Every day he sends his carrier pigeon to old Louie to check if a contract awaits him. A contract arrives to shoot the old lover of a mafia boss's precious daughter. But because the daughter witnesses the murder, the mob wants Ghost Dog dead too. Stars Forest Whitaker, Henry Silva and John Tormey.

programme.title: Zardoz
programme.desc: In a distant future, an Exterminator named Zed infiltrates a secluded society of immortal elites ruled by the godlike Zardoz. As he questions their power, the fragile order of their utopian world begins to collapse.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Japan Bitesize

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching For France
programme.desc: Avant garde Paris is steeped in the traditions of haute cuisine, dating back to Louis XVI's refinement of dining conventions with his 'art of the table' at the court of Versailles. At Alain Ducasse's Le Meurice Eva eats a single oyster dressed in rhubarb in a flamboyant display reminiscent of the Sun King's food theatre. And she meets the young chefs leading a new food scene, which blends French technique with global influences, including Mory Sacko at MoSuke, and Hanz Gueco at Le Cheval d'Or.

programme.title: Destination Flavour China Bitesize

programme.title: Come Dine With Me UK

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: When it comes to innovative American cheese makers, the state of Vermont has more than it's fair share. The foundations of the dairy industry began here in beautiful New England almost three centuries ago and by a strange coincidence the region has become the center of an exciting new revolution in artisan cheese making. Will and Ellie sample the famous cheddar and also the dairy’s delicious Baylee Hazen Blue cheese and discuss the many government challenges the dairy has faced in recent years and their close bond with the local economy.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: Big Daddy Dale Talde shows how to marinate, prep and grill up the biggest and best steaks out there. From a Hanger Steak with Salsa Verde to a Ribeye with Ginger Chili Relish, he tops it all off with the father of all steaks: the Porterhouse.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail
programme.sub-title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail Series 1 Ep 7
programme.desc: With Luke's busy life it's important to find the work life balance. Devoting Sunday as a family day, he explores the outdoors and the variety of restaurants Saigon has to offer. Arriving at The Deck on the Saigon River he meets executive chef Adrian Scott and learns the techniques to his Chicken Won Ton salad. Arriving at The Racha Room, Luke and Chris cook a Thai Red Duck leg Curry overlooking the busy restaurant before Luke plates up a light salmon sashimi with galangal dressing. Finishing the night, Luke entertains his friends at a dinner party making Banh Xeo.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail
programme.sub-title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail Series 1 Ep 8
programme.desc: Luke takes us to his top 3 traditional Pho Restaurants in Saigon and explains the differences between the styles of Pho Broth found throughout Vietnam. Luke then takes us behind the scenes at Grain, his cooking school in Saigon, where he aims to educate others on Vietnamese cooking. We get an inside look at his cooking studio classes cooking some impressive, yet simple traditional delights with pumpkin flowers, fish, prawns and his favourite Nuoc Cham sauce. Tying back into his morning ritual of Pho, he cooks a quick simple Pho Noodle recipe before ending the day at Xu bar.

programme.title: Project Fire
programme.desc: Steak. Few other words in the English language have such power to make our hearts beat faster and our mouths water than sizzling slabs of beef seared over live fire.

programme.title: Kriol Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Helani Doolah: Sop Sop, Sabee Domboi, And Marinated Fried Fish With Battered Banana
programme.desc: Using knowledge from her grandmother and other family members, Helani Doolah will show and teach us how to make some staple dishes that are made every day in the Torres Strait Islander community.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: Years ago Rachael came up with the phrase 'MYOTO,' short for 'make your own takeout,' to encourage people to recreate delicious restaurant meals in their own kitchens.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Laura is joined in the Market Kitchen by Chef Lillie, who makes the famous Vietnamese recipe Banh Mi. Mike changes the pace by cooking Grilled Raddicchio.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians are serious about their celebrations. The food, the company, the conversation, the music, and the wine are always abundant!

programme.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten

programme.title: Freshly Picked
programme.desc: Simon delivers a version of green curry that will please everyone, then takes paratha to the next level by wrapping crispy fried tofu in it. In the kitchen today, Jet Tranter is showing her Asian roots with triangle dumplings. Simon then heads to Pindatoes Produce & Products to pick some local fresh produce for his salt & pepper yams.

programme.title: Food Safari Earth
programme.desc: Maeve O'Meara celebrates the surprisingly abundant produce of winter across the most heart-warming recipes from around the world. She explores a spicy Singaporean white carrot cake made from daikon radish, known as chai tow kway. Kale is hailed as a superfood, but the Portuguese have been eating it for centuries as part of a delicious warm salad using finely sliced kale, toasted cornbread crumbs and pine nuts.

programme.title: Andy's East Coast Kitchen Crawl
programme.desc: Andy tours to the West side of Newfoundland to try his hand at cod jigging, taste uniquely-Newfoundland Vietnamese dishes and visit bees that produce some of the purest honey in the world.

programme.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
programme.desc: Serve up some delicious antipasto with Justine's recipe for pickled beetroot, Try out a sweet breakfast burrito or whip up a naughty crunchie ice cream cake.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: The vibes are nourishing in The Cook Up kitchen as Adam and his guests, Young Chef of the Year Jen Kwok Lee and comedian He Huang serve up some soul in a bowl.

programme.title: Taiwan Bites
programme.desc: Taiwan's culinary culture has adapted from Japanese, Chinese and Euro-American palates. Eric learns how a new generation of Taiwanese chefs are exercising their birth right as natural fusion makers.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Japan Bitesize
programme.desc: Some of your favourite moments and recipes from Adam Liaw's culinary and cultural journey through Japan from its frozen north, to cherry-blossomed mainland and tropical sun-soaked south.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail
programme.sub-title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail Series 1 Ep 9
programme.desc: Only weeks away from the grand opening, Luke takes us on a guided behind the scenes tour of his restaurant Vietnam House. The nerves have been building with the opening of Luke's dream fine dining restaurant in Saigon. Luke breaks down the barriers behind the logistics of opening a restaurant; from the kitchen to service, and finally, he welcomes us to the opening of Vietnam House. Luke, together with his team of hand-picked chefs, cook a couple of featured dishes of the new menu.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail
programme.sub-title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail Series 1 Ep 10
programme.desc: Luke hits the ground running in Hong Kong taking us to a few of his favourite spots to eat and drink in Hong Kong. Luke explores the hustle and bustle of the busy city to show his favourite food spots. Luke visits the best spot for milk tea, a Hong Kong style breakfast Congee and Rice Noodle and he visits one of the only traditional Yum Cha style teahouses in Central Hong Kong. After exploring the traditional side of Hong Kong, Luke visits his friend who adds a modern twist to a Chinese desert using liquid nitrogen.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: It's Pizza Time. Chef Dale Talde grills up amazing pizzas for every palate including a Detroit Style Pie, a Cheddar Naan Pie with a Spiced Chick Peas and Potatoes, and gives childhood favorite French Bread Pizza a much needed upgrade.

programme.title: Project Fire
programme.desc: For the rest of us, the ultimate symbol of barbecue - and test of a grill master's mettle - is ribs. But just which rack you relish depends on where you fire up your smoker or grill.

programme.sub-title: Eric Fejo: Goose Heart & Giblet Chilli, Marinated Buffalo Satays, Prawn Fritters
programme.desc: Eric Fejo tells us he is an average cook, but we think he is more than that. In this episode, Eric shows us his family recipes for three amazing dishes.

programme.sub-title: Bbq Burgers With Bean Dip Sauce
programme.desc: From her upstate kitchen, Rachael shows how to skip the drive-thru and craft the ultimate homemade burger topped with house-made barbecue sauce, American cheese, crispy bacon and a flavorful bean dip.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dinner doesn't have to feel like you're struggling. It can be as graceful as can be, just follow Lidia's lead!

Following tomato and eggplant curry, Simon heads back to Kinsfolk Farm for another tasty recipe, this time featuring brassica leaves.

programme.title: Andy's East Coast Kitchen Crawl
programme.desc: Andy hops on the ferry to Halifax where he goes behind a famous donair counter, samples Ghanaian comfort food and tries elevated modern twists on classic maritime dishes.

programme.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
programme.desc: Food coach, Judy Davie shares a beautifully fragrant Salmon recipe and Justine makes a traditional Russian Salad and serves up a Pear and Blueberry Pancake for dessert.

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.sub-title: Roquefort, Revisiting King Of The Blues
programme.desc: Roquefort is the most significant of all blue cheeses, it's one of the world's oldest cheeses and one of the few blue cheeses still made from raw milk. To find out what's changed since his last visit to the famous village of Roquefort-sur-Soulzon, Will and Ellie catch up with the makers of Papillon Roquefort, one of the most respected and well-known export brands from the region. Another of the finest boutique Roquefort producers is Carles and Will takes Ellie into the companies iconic limestone caves to speak to Delphine Carles and sample some of her delectable blue cheeses.
